title: L² difference-quotient (translation) estimate for Lipschitz functions on balls
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, u : ℝⁿ → ℝ L-Lipschitz (ℝⁿ = Euclid n), w ∈ ℝⁿ and r, R ∈ ℝ with r + ‖w‖ ≤ R. Then ∫_{B_r} (u(x) − u(x − w))² dx ≤ ‖w‖² ∫_{B_R} ‖Du‖², where B_ρ := B̆_ρ(0) is the open ball (empty if ρ ≤ 0) and Du = fderiv ℝ u with operator norm.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (u : Euclid n → ℝ) (L : NNReal) (w : Euclid n) (r R : ℝ), LipschitzWith L u → r + ‖w‖ ≤ R → ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) r, (u x - u (x - w)) ^ 2 ≤ ‖w‖ ^ 2 * ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, ‖fderiv ℝ u x‖ ^ 2
